figurative_meaning_en: A person who brings disgrace to the family
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার পরিবারের কুলাঙ্গার হয়ে উঠেছে তার অসৎ কাজের জন্য।
গ্রামে সকলে তাকে কুলাঙ্গার বলে অভিহিত করে।
example_sentences_in_english: He has become the black sheep of his family due to his dishonest actions.
Everyone in the village refers to him as a disgrace to his lineage.
note: This idiom reflects traditional Bengali emphasis on family reputation and social standing.
